title: Wild 110 Crans-Montana — Wildstrubel by UTMB 2027 (French)
publisher: UTMB World Series / Wildstrubel by UTMB
claims: The French race page gives 113 KM, 6,600 m of gain, a Friday 10 September 2027 start at 23:00 from Crans-Montana and a 30-hour limit.
The French page says runners collect 4 Running Stones, matching the main event page but not the 8 shown in the English race header.
The French route text names the Gemmi pass at 2,268 m, the Rawyl pass at 2,427 m and Cabane du Wildstrubel at 2,800 m as the highest point.
